subject: A resignation is not an apology, Premier
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Energy Minister resigned this week rather than answer for how farming families have been treated by her department. That is not justice. It is an exit.

And it must not become an alibi. She will not be used as a scapegoat: this was an attempt by the Government of Victoria to target farmers, and nothing will wash that clean.

The laws she wrote are still in place. Her department is still using the same tactics on the same families: uninvited attempts to get onto farms, security brought to an elderly farmer's door, and Greg Baldwin charged after ringing triple zero about trespassers on his own land, until the DPP withdrew every charge on 27 April 2026.

You lead this government, so this sits with you. Apologise to the farming families your government targeted. Order an independent investigation into how it happened.

Silence is no longer available, Premier.

Yours sincerely,

subject: She resigned. The system she built did not.
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Lily D'Ambrosio is gone. Everything she built is still standing.

Do not offer her up as the scapegoat. The targeting of farmers was not one minister's private project. It was an attempt by the Government of Victoria to target the people who feed this country, and one resignation does not wash it clean.

The access powers are still law. The department is still run on the same playbook farmers have been describing for months: turning up uninvited, pressing an elderly landholder with security in tow, and a farmer, Greg Baldwin, charged for calling triple zero about trespassers on his own farm. The DPP withdrew every one of those charges on 27 April 2026.

You are the Premier. Apologise to the families. Order an independent investigation into the targeting of farmers.

I would like your answer on the record.

Yours sincerely,

subject: One minister cannot carry this alone, Premier
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

I am writing because I can see what is coming: one minister resigns, the government calls the matter closed, and nothing changes for the families on the ground.

That will not do. Lily D'Ambrosio did not act alone and she will not be used as a scapegoat. The targeting of farmers was carried out by a department of the Government of Victoria, under laws passed by the Government of Victoria. Nothing will wash that clean except the truth.

So the demand comes to you, as the head of that government. Apologise to every farming family who was targeted. Order an independent investigation with the power to establish how uninvited access attempts, security at an elderly farmer's door, and the failed prosecution of Greg Baldwin were allowed to happen. Every charge against Mr Baldwin was withdrawn by the DPP on 27 April 2026.

A resignation was never the demand. The truth is the demand.

Yours sincerely,

subject: The apology farmers are owed is now yours to give
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

When a minister resigns without apologising, the debt does not leave with her. It passes to the government she served. That means it passes to you.

Farming families in this state have described uninvited attempts to get onto their land, security personnel brought to the door of a farmer in his eighties, and consultation that counted their refusals as agreement. Greg Baldwin rang triple zero about trespassers on his own farm and was the one charged. On 27 April 2026 the DPP withdrew every charge.

More than one hundred thousand Australians have joined the campaign asking for this to be put right. A resignation is not putting it right, and blaming one departed minister will not be accepted. This was your government's doing.

Apologise to the families. Order an independent investigation into the targeting of farmers.

Yours sincerely,

subject: Premier, your department is still doing it
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

I am writing to you rather than your new Energy Minister because this is bigger than one portfolio.

The conduct farmers have described did not resign this week. The laws that enabled it are still in force. The department that carried it out still reports to your government. Nothing about the way farming families are being treated on their own land has changed except the name on one office door.

Greg Baldwin was charged after calling triple zero about trespassers on his own farm. Every charge was withdrawn by the DPP on 27 April 2026. Other families tell of uninvited visits and of security brought to an elderly farmer's home. None of them has ever received an apology.

Do not let this end as one minister's story. It was the Government of Victoria that targeted farmers, and it is the Government of Victoria that must answer for it.

Apologise, Premier, and order an independent investigation.

Yours sincerely,

subject: Don't inherit her silence, Premier
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your former Energy Minister had every opportunity to answer for how farming families were treated by her department. She never did. This week she resigned instead.

You now have a choice about what you inherit. You can inherit her silence, or you can end it.

Ending it looks like this: an apology to the farming families who were put through it, and an independent investigation into how uninvited access attempts, security escorts to an elderly farmer's door, and the charging of Greg Baldwin for ringing triple zero on his own land were ever allowed to happen. The DPP withdrew every charge against Mr Baldwin on 27 April 2026. There was never a case.

What you cannot do is hang it all on her and move on. This was your government's conduct, not one woman's, and nothing will wash that clean except the truth.

Yours sincerely,

subject: 100,000 Australians are waiting on two words
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

More than one hundred thousand Australians have joined the campaign standing behind Victorian farming families. This week the Energy Minister who built the system they were fighting resigned. Not one of those families has heard the two words that matter: we apologise.

A resignation without an apology is an escape, not an answer. And it changes nothing on the ground: the powers she legislated are still being used by a department your government runs.

Nor will Victorians accept her as the scapegoat. The targeting of farmers was an act of the Government of Victoria. It is the government, through its Premier, that owes the apology.

So apologise, Premier. And order an independent investigation into the targeting of farmers, including how Greg Baldwin came to be charged after ringing triple zero about trespassers on his own farm, before the DPP withdrew every charge on 27 April 2026.

Yours sincerely,

subject: Farmers are still afraid to call the police, Premier
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

There are farmers in Victoria who hesitate to ring the police when strangers come onto their land. They saw what happened to Greg Baldwin, who made that call and was the one charged, until the DPP withdrew every charge on 27 April 2026.

That fear did not resign this week. It is still out there in the paddocks, along with the access powers your government legislated and the department that used them.

Restoring trust starts with honesty from the top, not with a departed minister carrying the blame out the door for everyone else. This was the Government of Victoria targeting farming families, and nothing will wash that clean.

Apologise to the families who were targeted. Order an independent investigation so it cannot happen again.

You are the Premier. This is now yours to fix or yours to own.

Yours sincerely,

subject: One minister gone. Nothing settled.
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

The minister who wrote the laws is gone. Everything she is responsible for is still here.

The laws are still in force. The department still answers to your government. The families are still waiting: the elderly farmer whose door was darkened by security personnel, the farms visited uninvited across this state, and Greg Baldwin, charged after ringing triple zero about trespassers on his own land before the DPP withdrew every charge on 27 April 2026.

I do not accept, and Victorians will not accept, that one resignation closes this. She was not a lone actor and she will not be used as a scapegoat. This was an attempt by the Government of Victoria to target farmers.

Apologise to the farming families, Premier. Order an independent investigation into the targeting of farmers.

Until then, nothing is settled.

Yours sincerely,

subject: Finish this properly, Premier
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

I will keep this short, because thousands of us are writing and the ask has not changed.

Your government's treatment of farming families has been described to us over and over: uninvited attempts to access farms, security brought to press an elderly landholder, and Greg Baldwin charged after ringing triple zero about trespassers on his own farm. The DPP withdrew every charge on 27 April 2026.

The minister responsible resigned this week without a word of apology. That closes nothing, and she will not be the scapegoat for a government that targeted farmers.

Apologise to the families.

Order an independent investigation into the targeting of farmers.

Until both happen, this campaign continues, and it is growing.

Yours sincerely,
